name: Family pocket-money planner
audience: Parents or caregivers who want the household cost of pocket money to be explicit.
summary: Set a monthly amount per child and see the household total for the year.
description: Each child has an amount and a note about what it is expected to cover. The workbook totals the month and the year. It does not decide what a child should be paid.
benefits: See the year cost before you promise an increase
Write what the money is meant to cover
Keep each child on a separate row
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
disclaimer: This workbook organises figures you type in. It is not financial, credit, insurance, or tax advice. Rates, fees, and laws change. A qualified adviser should review decisions that affect debt, tax, medical cover, or retirement.
